_doc: #1547 tier-4 downloadable pack descriptor: the IEEE MA-L registry (6 hex, tab, organization; sorted) read by libs:wifi OuiTable through FleetPack. The blob is fetched on demand from url, verified against bytes + sha256, cached in the app's filesDir and used offline. Regenerate sha256/bytes with: sha256sum data/fleet/packs/wifi-oui.tsv (the runtime-data guard fails when they drift).
